name: SoFi Smart Card

apr.notes: SoFi states the Smart Card has no interest charges; the balance must be paid in full each month. Late payment fee up to $41.

credit_required.notes: Secured credit card backed by SoFi Checking and Savings balances, which set the spending limit (maximum credit limit $500,000). No minimum security deposit. Requires a SoFi Checking and Savings account. Soft credit pull to apply; approval results in a hard pull.

base_rate.description: No earn rate on other purchases is stated.

notes: Issued by SoFi Bank, N.A. Cash back is issued as SoFi Member Rewards points (5 points per $1 at eligible grocery stores; superstores, warehouse clubs, convenience stores and grocery and meal-kit delivery services are excluded). The foreign transaction fee is not shown on the public page, so it is null. The Mastercard network package is not named, so network_tier is none.
